decisions.statement: A page type is gathered together with every page type extending that page type.
Which page types extend a page type is read from `page-type-descent`.
A page type under the page type named that no page is filed under is passed over.
The properties a row is read by are the ones that row's own page type declares.
What a page type carries is read from the file beside that page type.
A page type with no such file beside it has what it carries worked out here.
A calculation is read from that page type's own declarations.
The loader is handed the path a calculation's code file is at and a reader.
That reader answers the text at any path.
The rows a query asked for are not every page a calculation reaches.
A calculation is worked out over the rows named rather than over every row gathered.
A calculation reaches every row gathered however few rows are worked out.
A row is keyed by its path.
A calculation reaching a slug reaches the first row gathered under that slug.
A slug no row gathered carries is looked for in the index.
A page is named to the index as that page's page type and its slug joined by a slash.
A page reached through the index has its own page type's calculations.
Which pages name a page under one property is read from beside that page.
A page type's values are read once however many pages reach into that page type.
One source reads the index through one reader, and holds that reader no longer.
No page type is read until a calculation reaches into that page type.
Nothing here reads a question or refuses a question.
Nothing here orders or narrows or cuts the rows this module gathers.
Nothing here writes.

definition: the rows of one page type and of every page type under it, each worked against its own type
